correctness.rationale: I independently rebuilt the quadratic Poisson tensor and Schouten linearization. Constant bivector cocycles have dimension 2 with basis d01,d23; Pi+t d01 remains Poisson and has rank 2 for t!=0. The degree<=2 cocycle system has 90 unknowns, rank 56 and kernel dimension 34; affine-vector-field coboundaries have rank 16, leaving an 18-dimensional quotient slice, and d01 is not an affine coboundary. The smooth-origin obstruction follows because Pi is quadratic, so every smooth coboundary [Pi,X] vanishes at 0 whereas d01 does not. The stored exact radial-minor route is consistent with these checks.

value.rationale: The package isolates several structurally distinct obstructions to localizing a natural infinitesimal Poisson deformation and explicitly leaves the general nonradial smooth problem open. The constant, radial and low-degree cohomology calculations are mutually reinforcing and mathematically useful boundary information rather than a one-off computation.
